sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing in force for BR-225 (rev B) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with yield of at least 250 MPa. EN AW-7075 is a different alloy, not the drawing material, and nothing shows it meets SC-BR225-YS.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-225 belongs to PRG-X (Aurelia). Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3 and requires written approval (PPAP) for a change of material, plus 90 days' notice. No approval is on file.
EN AW-7075 is not in the material master, so there is no yield or temper data. Someone must supply the data, including the temper offered. Owner: the quality engineer for aluminium parts.

sources.quote: Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No EN 10204 3.1 certificate for EN AW-7075 exists from any supplier. The supplier and temper are also not named, so the supplier quality engineer must ask for the certificate.
